description: Maintenance release accepted with disclosed limits; full_quality_pass=false. Recipe integration and guarded production canaries are approved; persistent activation remains pending live evidence. LLooM owns orchestration, admission, readiness, routing and telemetry. The image is built by Enntity/sparkqwen install/build.sh and pulled by immutable registry digest. FP4-Local checkpoint, 8x262k profile file and native MTP settings remain unchanged. This recipe explicitly overrides GPU memory utilization to 0.80 with a 104 GiB hard container cap and per-node admission estimate; activation requires separate live memory and gateway canaries. Engine source reference `sparkqwen/fidelity-rc-20261019` is an annotated tag, not a new branch. Maintenance review: https://github.com/Enntity/sparkqwen/blob/050743206a7fd921eaa5acf1cbe50653b9f155cc/results/2026-10-20-fidelity-review/qualification.json (SHA256 d591b033b0c396a2b0222b6c63136bc323e1bb5b69a206eac3c7df942b24be8b). Publication acceptance SHA256 7e2e699de3e8d06cb4a6eb3a3df5add15c8aaf18172f0f299aa1a0628ea91de0; original 0.88 production disposition SHA256 7b626caea8a546f868854d5c07eeaed103f5bf0c4ba3048b0e2d16fa85ede346. The separate bounded 0.80/104 GiB canary disposition is SHA256 ba97c1c2d26d7fc8648c12ee6c36ad8b07b5c64e2ddfd88b94f039166fd66d95; persistent activation remains unapproved. Automatic tools with strict JSON can choose an unrelated tool; canonical NLL retains a reference residual and needle recall is 59/60. No numerical parity, universal speculative equivalence or lossless claim. Exact limitations are recorded in hardware notes. Live LLooM and gateway verification remain separate.

notes: Maintenance release accepted with disclosed limits; full_quality_pass=false. Recipe integration and guarded production canaries are approved; persistent activation remains pending live evidence. Engine source reference `sparkqwen/fidelity-rc-20261019` is an annotated tag, not a new branch. Maintenance review: https://github.com/Enntity/sparkqwen/blob/050743206a7fd921eaa5acf1cbe50653b9f155cc/results/2026-10-20-fidelity-review/qualification.json (SHA256 d591b033b0c396a2b0222b6c63136bc323e1bb5b69a206eac3c7df942b24be8b). Publication acceptance SHA256 7e2e699de3e8d06cb4a6eb3a3df5add15c8aaf18172f0f299aa1a0628ea91de0; original 0.88 production disposition SHA256 7b626caea8a546f868854d5c07eeaed103f5bf0c4ba3048b0e2d16fa85ede346. The separate bounded 0.80/104 GiB canary disposition is SHA256 ba97c1c2d26d7fc8648c12ee6c36ad8b07b5c64e2ddfd88b94f039166fd66d95; persistent activation remains unapproved.

TP2 with expert parallelism 2 across the private ConnectX RoCE fabric. MASTER_ADDR, FABRIC_INTERFACE and FABRIC_HCA come from the cluster node config. FABRIC_HCA and NCCL_IB_HCA are the node's explicit, node-local cluster.nodes[ID].fabricHca list (exact RDMA device names, no :port syntax); LLooM requires it on every participating node and never guesses an HCA from the NIC name, and FABRIC_SIBLINGS=0 stops the engine from adding a backchannel. Explicit lists may include both verified rails.
The worker is admitted first (rank 1) and readiness-checked through its container state; the leader starts second (rank 0), serves 127.0.0.1:8893 (fixed by the image) and owns routing.

The production operating point uses SPARKQWEN_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.80 and a 104 GiB hard container cap and admission estimate per node. The published 8x262k profile file and its 4096 MiB load-time OOM guard are unchanged. Host admission policy is unchanged; startup memory, long-context and gateway canaries are required before activation. Published benchmarks used the profile default 0.88 and do not qualify this smaller KV pool.
Licenses: the Atlas engine in the image is AGPL-3.0-only (not included in LLooM). nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local is under the NVIDIA Open Model License per its model card; read it before use.
Full quality gate remains failed. This release does not establish numerical parity, universal speculative equivalence, a lossless recipe, or an all-quality-pass result.

Canonical prompt NLL is 1.0659923317039264, a residual of +0.0404426398902944 against the observed A4 reference. The earlier native baseline was higher at 1.1216532930400633. These comparisons do not establish a cause.

Needle recall is 59/60 versus the retained historical 60/60 result. One lookup failed at 163,290 prompt tokens. Speculative ON and OFF at concurrency 1 returned the same wrong decoded fields; the original concurrency-4 run and different cache histories limit this comparison.
Automatic tool selection combined with strict JSON can choose an unrelated tool. The explicit tool_choice: none control returned the correct JSON.

Performance is mixed, including slower Rig medians and concurrency-2/4/8 cells. The matrix has one invocation per cell; its concurrency-1 32K cell is slower. Four warm-conversation request bodies differ because earlier responses generate later history.
Logit bias on the first prefill token remains an inherited unsupported contract.
The oversized PNG probe establishes header admission only; it does not prove full pixel decoding.
